lesson.title: Pronouns: I & You
lesson.theory: Two of the most useful words in any language — talking about yourself, and talking to someone else.

lesson.title: The verb "to be"
lesson.theory: The infinitive is es. Remember Type 1 / Type 2 from the last lesson? es ends in a consonant — Type 2. That means the present tense adds just -e (not -de, like a Type 1 word would).

lesson.title: Good and bad
lesson.theory: Two simple describing words — they go right after the verb, same word order as in English.

lesson.title: Putting it together
lesson.theory: Subject + verb + description — the same order English uses, so these should feel familiar.

lesson.prompt:
Unscramble these words into a correct sentence:
ven / vi / ese
